plan.notes: Source: Auburn University Bulletin 2026-2027, official term-by-term curriculum table at https://bulletin.auburn.edu/undergraduate/collegeofliberalarts/departmentofpsychologypsyc/psychology_major/. College of Liberal Arts, Psychology (PSYC). Term subtotals verified against the published table (13/13/14/15/17/17/15/16 = 120). Psychology elective Groups A, B, C follow the bulletin's group definitions (Group A/B electives in junior year, Group C in senior year). The sophomore 'Select one of the following' social-science slot lists SOCY 1000, ANTH 1000, and GEOS 1010 or GEOG 1010 as the options. UNIV 4AA0 Achieve the Creed is a 0-credit university requirement (required_zero).
